AFB_Speed_F.note: Re-swept by Fable 2026-10-11: 0.3 = 20 km/h, 0.5 = 55, 0.7 = 90, 0.9 = 125, 1 = 140, in 5 km/h steps; the on/off is on the lever.

ThrottleAndBrake_F.note: Re-swept by Fable 2026-10-11 14:20 in 0.02 steps: brake side continuous and linear 0..0.45 (output -10..-0.22, i.e. (iv-0.45)/0.045), 0 at 0.46..0.52, 0.53/0.54 snap to 0.55 = output 1 (10 %), power continuous 0.56..1 (output 20*(iv-0.5)). Stores with the reverser showing 0 (the reverser state is not readable through the API).

interlocks: ReverserInputOnly_F (identifier Reverser) is display-only: sets through the API are ignored (stored 0.5, output 0) and the Reverser_Forward_F / Reverser_Off_F / Reverser_Backward_F push buttons accept 1 and 0 without any effect, also after ActivateCab_F. The game keys W (forward) and S (backward) do move it (HUD toast "Reverser Forward" / "Reverser Off"), but no node reflects the state, so the profile drives the reverser with the keys.
ThrottleAndBrake_F and AFB_Speed_F store their full range through the API whatever the reverser shows.
